name: suede-docs-site
description: Redirect page for docs.suedeai.ai — points to the canonical Suede Labs AI docs repo on GitHub.

paragraphs: Static documentation index for docs.suedeai.ai. The canonical Suede AI developer documentation lives on GitHub at Suede-AI/suede-docs and is mirrored publicly at JasonColapietro/suede-docs.

The site is static HTML with no build step: index.html (overview and docs index), the API guides (quickstart.html, endpoints.html, endpoints/.html, errors.html, python-sdk.html, discovery.html) and ai-instructions.html. vercel.json sets cleanUrls, so quickstart.html is served at /quickstart, and canonicals use that form. suede-docs-og.svg is the editable source for the committed 1200×630 suede-docs-og.png social card.

The API guides document the live endpoints on app.suedeai.ai. Every price, field and response on them comes from the live discovery documents (/.well-known/x402, /openapi.json, /api/v1/catalog) or from a live request, and each page lists its sources. Re-check them against those documents when the catalog changes. The guides share the home page block, and scripts/verify-site.mjs enforces it, along with the prev/next reading order, sitemap and llms.txt entries, and the keyword map.
